answer: Posted collateral must equal 6 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. Because the vault collateral is checked against the harbor claim at intake, the kernel audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases therefore has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. That is 21 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
